meta.freshnessBoundary: TourAPI live facts may be current in phase 1; every 부산 row in this artifact is a stored static snapshot and is never labelled latest.

phase1Policy.apply: TourAPI complete-list active/inactive membership, modified facts, and returned common fields only after exact-ID identity gate.
phase1Policy.preserve: Busan-only reviewed fields and every app-derived category/dwell/classification/relationship field.
phase1Policy.forbid: Calling stored Busan values latest, whole-record provider priority, live auto-reclassification, static resurrection after explicit TourAPI deletion.

normalization.title: NFKC + lowercase + remove whitespace/punctuation/symbols; reviewed aliases are exact normalized alternatives

autoApplyAllRequired: provider source ID exactly equals the reviewed mapping
normalized live title equals current title or one reviewed alias
live coordinate is valid and no more than 100m from the mapped place when coordinates are returned
source ID still maps to the same internal contentId and not another merged/site-group relation
reviewRequiredIfAny: normalized live title is neither current title nor a reviewed alias
same provider source ID resolves to multiple internal IDs
live identity is closer to or names another mergedPlaceId/siteGroup member instead of the mapped contentId
probableIdReuseSignals: unknown title and coordinate movement exceeds 250m
coordinate movement exceeds 1000m even when title is retained
contentTypeId changes together with unknown title or coordinate movement
reviewRules.partialResponseRule: missing optional field does not erase stored value; only complete-list-confirmed inactive membership removes the TourAPI-linked place from the session; detail failure is not deletion
reviewRules.scopeNote: These thresholds are audit proposals for adapter fixtures. They are not recommendation policy and are not written into UI, engine, API adapter, or DB code by this task.

observedCurrentAdapterContract.note: Observed from the current worktree only; this data task did not modify the adapter.

blockingAmbiguityForMappingLayer.currentShape: snapshot.places contains active approved IDs whose detailIntro2 succeeded; partial.failures are not content-ID scoped
blockingAmbiguityForMappingLayer.consequence: an approved ID omitted from a partial snapshot cannot be distinguished as inactive from active-with-detail-failure
blockingAmbiguityForMappingLayer.requiredResolution: return a complete active-approved ID set plus content-ID-scoped detail failures, or return one status per approved ID: active_ready | active_detail_failed | inactive

integrationHandoff.engineInputAfterResolution: accepted session places only, retaining internal contentId/category/subCategory/dwell/classification/relationship fields and excluding confirmed inactive or identity-conflict rows
